name: p5.keyed
description: Keyframe animation for p5.js: set values at a few points in time and Keyed blends everything in between.
author: Dominique Schmitz (http://www.domizai.ch)

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/p5.keyed.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=p5keyed --target=es2020 --outfile=lib/p5.keyed.js && esbuild src/p5.keyed.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=p5keyed --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=lib/p5.keyed.min.js && esbuild src/p5.keyed.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=lib/p5.keyed.esm.js
